items.title: Nano Banana 2.1 now available on AI Gateway

items.title: Adobe releases Photoshop 27.11
items.excerpt: Photoshop 27.11 adds Enhance Edge, an AI option (20 generative credits per use) that reduces colour fringing in Remove Background masks, and lets users pick OpenAI's GPT Image 2 for Generate Image and Prompt to edit.

items.title: New 3D software you may have missed: 4 October 2026
items.excerpt: Weekly CG tools roundup: Lightricks' LTX-2.5 AI world model gains Alpha Gen matte generation plus Native Resolution, Refine and Restore features; new motion graphics app Caddis supports nine AI models including Nano Banana Pro and Seedance 2.

items.title: Photoshop Can Now Move the Light in Your Photo
items.excerpt: Photoshop's new Relight feature lets you reposition, soften, and recolor light in finished images using sliders. Jesús Ramirez tests how it handles portraits, interiors, and composites, and where it falls short.

items.title: How Hark designed an AI assistant that's actually helpful
items.excerpt: With a chatbot interface and agentic capabilities, Hark Pro checks the boxes of a 2026 AI release, but its designers rethought the core premise of how an assistant should help, prioritising privacy and usefulness.

items.title: Is Meta's new AI agent easier to trust because it's cute?
items.excerpt: Meta's Muse agent comes with an avatar you design and a keyring gadget. Few people would hand Meta their passwords, yet it topped the US App Store, raising questions about cute character design as a trust strategy.

items.title: The taste paradox: why the skill everyone says matters is the one we've stopped building
items.excerpt: Designers say taste is the last human advantage over AI, but the world and now the tools make it almost impossible to develop, and teams respond by de-risking even further.

items.title: OpenAI launches visual ads that appear alongside image generation results

items.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
items.excerpt: Personal AI agents promise to shop, book flights, and make reservations for you. But deliberate blocks and anti-bot defenses are getting in the way, leaving consumers caught in the middle. A new standard aims to help.

items.title: Mistral's new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
items.excerpt: French AI lab Mistral AI has released Mistral Large 4, a new large multimodal model aiming to leapfrog both American and Chinese rivals.
